## Live Testnet reconciliation snapshot (2026-11-10)

- Target: GH Connect Testnet Supabase (tpckwgdsjlkzscjlxiwe, eu-west-1). Mainnet was not accessed or modified.
- Sixteen distinct additive reconciliation operations were applied and verified. Supabase records eighteen generated history rows because the idempotent duplicate-index cleanup and RLS policy cleanup were each submitted twice: phase7_durable_community_governance_reconciliation (20261110085225), withdrawal_rpc_acl_and_recovery_atomicity (20261110085344), wallet_recovery_reset_lock_race_guard (20261110085351), phase1_curation_community_guard_reconciliation (20261110091735), server_only_security_definer_rpc_acl_hardening (20261110092119), function_search_path_hardening (20261110092226), and remove_verified_duplicate_indexes (20261110092347 and 20261110092407), rls_policy_dedup_and_initplan_optimization (20261110093142 and 20261110093227), supporting_foreign_key_indexes (20261110093228), marketplace_orders_list_rpc_alias_fix (20261110102610), Run #269 revoke_client_table_write_and_sequence_privileges (20261110174922), Run #270 community_chat_membership_revocation_and_reconciliation (20261110182120), and Run #270 community_server_filter_search_reconciliation (20261110183004), and Run #271 story_idempotent_create_and_owned_media_guard (20261110185525), story_read_path_and_viewer_roster_indexes (20261110185528), and post_create_idempotent_owner_and_payload_guard (20261110190531).
- These generated records are not the canonical source filenames' original versions. No original migration history for 1–189 was available, despite the user's manual SQL Editor application. Do not run supabase db push, migration repair, or hand-edit migration history until every existing object and all historical migrations have been reconciled. Never replay migrations 1–189 by assumption.
- Live schema: 140 public tables, RLS enabled on all 140, 133 policies, 13 intentionally policy-less RLS tables (deny-client pattern), and 0/290 public SECURITY DEFINER functions executable by anon/authenticated. 286 remain service_role-executable; four internal/legacy/disabled helpers retain their pre-existing non-service-role state. The postgres-owned public function, table and sequence default ACLs now exclude anon/authenticated. Existing public tables retain SELECT/RLS but grant no client INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER; all nine public sequences deny client USAGE/SELECT/UPDATE. The separate supabase_admin default ACL remains unchanged because the migration role is not a member of supabase_admin; all current public tables are postgres-owned.
- Security advisor: no remaining SECURITY DEFINER client-execution warnings and no mutable search_path warnings. The 13 RLS-enabled/no-policy findings are INFO and must not be “fixed” with generic client policies.
- Performance advisor: duplicate-index, unindexed-foreign-key, auth RLS initplan and multiple-permissive-policy findings are all zero. unused-index candidates remain (including the newly added FK and community-search indexes on a low-traffic Testnet); do not drop unused indexes without workload evidence.
- Identity/profile snapshot: 3 Pi identities, 3 public IDs, 4 profiles, 4 account anchors and 213 custom sessions (6 active). One account/profile has no Pi identity, no transactions and no active session; one expired orphan session remains. It was not deleted or auto-linked.
- Media: gh-media is private, 50 MiB; 39 ready asset rows map one-to-one to 39 storage objects, with no orphan assets/objects or expired open uploads. This matches the current secure signed-upload/authorized-delivery implementation.
- Economy snapshot: 59 GHC transactions (38 posted, 4 Daily Claim pending, 17 expired); 24 unified earnings-ledger entries; 15 payment intents (8 fulfilled, 5 cancelled, 2 old APPROVED membership intents with no txid/completion/entitlement); 3 active memberships (1 VIP, 2 VVIP); 1 referral attribution but 0 referral rewards; 0 Pi cashback entitlements/periods/payouts; 0 GHC transfer requests; 0 GHC withdrawal requests; 0 bank/seller payout requests. Two Daily Claim holds are over 48 hours and two remain within the lock. Two Treasury cases were opened: membership provider reconciliation and aged Daily Claim reconciliation.
- Pi earnings payouts: 13 requests (10 released and 3 uncertain). All three uncertain requests have no provider payment ID, txid, receipt or provider verification, no active execution lease, and three total execution attempts across the set. Their ledger holds remain reserved. Do not auto-release, settle or retry them; reconcile the provider's authoritative incomplete-payment state first.
- Marketplace: 8 listings (1 active, 3 paused, 4 removed; 4 GHC and 4 PI; no negative/zero availability), 0 orders and no seller payout requests. The single fulfilled Marketplace Pi intent is a listing_fee tied to an existing listing, not an orphan order. Variants table/columns are absent; required base listing/order/expiry RPCs, stock trigger and Phase 21 event-journal constraints exist. Migrations 194–195 remain unapplied; there are no orders to exercise payment/fulfilment. Curation: 0 votes/activity; GHC curation credits remain intentionally disabled by the Daily-Claim-only issuance policy. Community: 1 community, 1 member and 5 posts; public server-side search and bounded pagination are installed (one-match smoke test passed).
- The Pi custom identity/session system is populated; an empty Supabase auth.users table does not mean the app has no accounts.
- Marketplace migration 195 was found incompatible with the existing Phase 21 event-journal schema. Its source has been corrected to reuse the original immutable journal and event vocabulary. Testnet preflight now confirms the expected Phase 21 journal contract; migrations 194–195 remain unapplied pending disposable PostgreSQL validation and transactional inventory/payment/fulfilment tests.

## Apply policy

| Class | Action |
|---|---|
| **REQUIRED** | Candidate for operator review; reconcile target schema/history first, apply to disposable PostgreSQL/Testnet, verify, then seek explicit promotion approval. |
| **REQUIRES_APPROVAL** | Product and security review, then explicit approval. |
| **PROPOSAL** | **Do not apply** without written approval. |
| **REVIEW_REQUIRED** | New, unreconciled, or sequencing-sensitive; inspect dependencies and validate on disposable PostgreSQL/Testnet before any application. |

**Never bulk-apply this inventory.** Supabase CLI does not enforce these documentation classifications: any pending SQL file left in the canonical migration directory may be eligible for supabase db push. Do not run supabase db push until every pending file has been individually approved and target history reconciled. Filename order is not proof of migration history or safety. Reconcile Testnet and Mainnet independently, and preserve data.

## Release-readiness notes

- The current inventory contains **220** migration files. Counts and row order are generated from the canonical directory.
- Migrations with newer sequence identifiers are not automatically invalid, but their dependencies, approval status, and target-project history must be reviewed before execution.
- Historical self-curation guard/allowance migrations conflict; the Phase 1 reconciliation migration is the current final policy and explicitly denies self-curation in both preflight and atomic write paths. Verify the final function definition on disposable PostgreSQL and Testnet before applying.
- The marketplace reservation migration remains unverified against PostgreSQL. Do not enable finite-stock production sales until concurrency, payment races, expiry, cancellation, and recovery pass.
- This checklist is not a deployment approval and is not a record of applied migrations.
